vopros: Who in the US can check what AI assistants say about my company?

vyzhimka.tekst:
In the U.S., you can use **AI brand-monitoring platforms** or hire a **digital-marketing, SEO, or reputation-management agency** that offers AI visibility audits.

Examples of platforms include **Profound, OtterlyAI, Brand24/Chatbeat, and Keyword.com**. They can check selected questions across assistants and AI search tools, then report whether your company appears, how it’s described, which competitors are mentioned, and what sources are cited.

Agencies such as **WebFX** and **Netpeak US** also advertise AI-search or generative-engine-optimization audits and ongoing monitoring.

When comparing options, ask which assistants they actually test, how often they rerun prompts, whether you can choose questions relevant to your customers, and whether they provide the original answers and citations. Results are samples: AI responses can vary by prompt, location, account, and time, so no audit can guarantee a complete or permanent picture.
